- [ ] order.placed includes total_cents
- [ ] web-storefront and fulfilment keep working unchanged
- [ ] An alert fires if order.placed stops being published

Repo: `checkout-api`

- `place_order()` (app/routers/orders.py:11)
- `publish_order_event()` (app/events.py:5)
- `Cart` (app/models.py:11)
- `Order` (app/models.py:27)
- `cached_cart()` (app/cache.py:5)

## API surface this touches

- `GET /v1/carts/{cart_id}`
- `POST /v1/orders`
- `POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/cancel`

Other repos call these endpoints: web-storefront. Keep the contract backward compatible.

## Conventions

- Money is integer cents (total_cents), never floats.
- Events keep their existing fields; add new ones, never rename.
